name: Coercion
desc: Shoot a blast of roar in front of you scaring any afflicted entities.

name: Corrosion
desc: Empower your attacks with the deadly effect of Corrosion, toggleable when mastered.

name: Gravity Field
desc: Weaken gravity around yourself to make movement easier or create a variously sized sphere granting previous effects while debuffing enemies.

name: Gravity Flight
desc: Manipulate gravity to allow flight, your momentum from before will be continued.

name: Hydraulic Propulsion
desc: Propel yourself at high speeds underwater.

name: Paralysis
desc: Empower your attacks with the effect of Paralysis, toggleable when mastered.

name: Poison
desc: Empower your attacks with the effect of Poison, toggleable when mastered.

name: Ranged Barrier
desc: Place down differently sized barriers which block enemies in or out. Strong attacks can still destroy them.

name: Self-Regeneration
desc: Speed up your body’s natural regeneration to increase your survivability.

name: Strength
desc: Use magicule to strengthen your muscles.

name: Telepathy
desc: Give orders to tames when looking at them through commands.

name: Thought Communication
desc: Send commands to nearby allies and become able to instruct them to attack players.

name: Voice Cannon
desc: Fire powerful blasts of concentrated sound waves by producing loud vocal sounds atomizing weaker targets.

name: Water Blade
desc: Shoot out a blade of water which flies in a straight line.

name: Water Current Control
desc: Manipulate water around you to propel yourself in any direction.

name: All-seeing Eye
desc: Go into a 3rd person mode, with your increased POV you gain movement and action buffs as well as an upgrade to Presence Sense.

name: Analytical Appraisal
desc: Assess the strength of your opponents to gain insight into their overall strength.

name: Black Flame
desc: Command the tempest infused flames to spew out black flames at your enemies or even shoot deadly fireballs and hell flares.

name: Black Lightning
desc: Shoot black lightning at varying strength, or summon a massive storm which attacks any non-allied mobs. A short range plasma blast can also be used to melt even the strongest of foes.

name: Body Double
desc: Use a tenth of your magical power to summon an identical clone which takes increased damage but will fight for you until the end. The user can exchange places with the clone but risk taking increased damage.

name: Chant Annulment
desc: Become able to cast mastered magic instantly, in water or even under the effects of silence.

name: Danger Sense
desc: Receive a mental warning when entities with hostile intent enter your proximity.

name: Demon Lord Haki
desc: Unleash your Demonic aura causing those around you to quake in fear.

name: Earth Manipulation
desc: Boosts the power of Earth abilities by a decent amount.

name: Flame Manipulation
desc: Boosts the power of fire abilities by a decent amount.

name: Godwolf Sense
desc: Improve your senses to be able to see in the dark or even spot invisible entities nearby.

name: Gravity Manipulation
desc: Boosts Gravity abilities by a decent amount and allows you to fly without hindrance.

name: Haki
desc: Project your aura to cow nearby foes into submission.

name: Heat Wave
desc: Shoot a fiery projectile or summon a short-ranged fire storm which will damage all nearby entities.

name: Heavenly Eye
desc: Project your otherworldly gaze to see all nearby entities and partially ignore dodging abilities.

name: Hero Haki
desc: Use your Hero Aura to inspire your allies and terrify your enemies.

name: Infinite Regeneration
desc: Use your massive amount of magicule to instantly regenerate from all but the most grievous of injuries.

name: Law Manipulation
desc: Bypass many restrictions by manipulating the law of the world.

name: Lightning Manipulation
desc: Boosts Lightning abilities by a decent amount.

name: Magic Aura
desc: Empower your attacks with many elemental aura.

name: Magic Jamming
desc: Interferes with skills, magics, flight and transformation with mastery.

name: Magic Sense
desc: Using magicule to sense entities around.

name: Majesty
desc: By boosting your reputation with the villagers, gain a permanent Hero of the Village effect.

name: Mana Manipulation
desc: Grant better control on Mana with less magicule cost on casted Magics and less damage taken from magicule-based attacks.

name: Molecular Manipulation
desc: Use your intricate knowledge and power over the building blocks of the world to obtain blocks and move entities.

name: Mortal Fear
desc: Inspire a gripping fear of death in weaker enemies while empowering your allies.

name: Multilayer Barrier
desc: Protect yourself with a multitude of powerful defensive barriers.

name: Sacred Haki
desc: Strike fear into the hearts of evil and give strength to your allies.

name: Sage
desc: Increase the speed at which you learn and master skills, magic and arts.

name: Sense Heat Source
desc: Highlights entities that generate heat nearby.

name: Shadow Motion
desc: Melt into the shadows and move unseen by all but the most keen observers.

name: Snake Eye
desc: Apply various debuff on targets on sight.

name: Sound Manipulation
desc: Boosts Sound abilities by a decent amount.

name: Spatial Manipulation
desc: Boosts Space abilities by a decent amount and manipulate space to empower your ranged attacks.

name: Spatial Motion
desc: Tear space asunder granting yourself and your allies safe passage.

name: Steel Strength
desc: Strengthen your muscles and gain an increase in damage, toggleable when mastered.

name: Stick Steel Thread
desc: Manipulate threads in various form.

name: Strengthen Body
desc: Strengthen your body to better protect yourself against attacks.

name: Thought Acceleration
desc: Increase the speed at which you think to cast magic more quickly as well as to increase your reaction speed.

name: Ultra-Instinct
desc: Enhance your sense to dodge physical impact.

name: Ultraspeed Regeneration
desc: Boost your bodies healing to nearly impossible levels

name: Universal Perception
desc: Combine all magic, sound and heat sense to detect entities around.

name: Water Manipulation
desc: Boosts Water abilities by a decent amount.

name: Weather Manipulation
desc: Use magicule to manipulate the weather.

name: Wind Manipulation
desc: Boosts Wind abilities by a decent amount.

name: Beast Transformation
desc: Transform into a beast to restore your vitality and boost your physical body. The transformation will grant great physical prowess but leave a toll on your body.

name: Blood Mist
desc: Spill your own blood to summon a mist which steals the vitality of your enemies and can be blown up to harm any nearby entities or shoot a powerful blood beam.

name: Body Armor
desc: Protect yourself from harm by summoning armorsaurus scales around your body.

name: Charm
desc: Use your inherent power to turn your opponents neutral or to temporarily dominate weak opponents.

name: Divine Ki Release
desc: Use your Divine Ki to amplify your battlewill to deal more damage and destroy weaker equipment.

name: Dragon Ear
desc: Use your sensitive hearing to precisely pin the location of any nearby mobs which make sound.

name: Dragon Eye
desc: Use your powerful sight to access the power of any entities and see in the far distance.

name: Dragon Mode
desc: Once a day, draw out your monstrous potential to double your EP and to boost your physical prowess. Doing this will leave a temporary toll on your body.

name: Dragon Skin
desc: Transform your skin into scales which become tougher as you gain more EP.

name: Drain
desc: Steal the vitality of your opponent and temporarily transform this skill into one of theirs to potentially turn the tables.

name: Eye of Truth
desc: By obtaining the mythical Hero Egg, the veil of deception is torn apart. No illusion or concealment can deceive your sight, and your vision becomes perfect.

name: Flame Breath
desc: Spew fire to burn away enemies and set fire to the land.

name: Giantification
desc: Grow beyond your normal size to gain increased strength and reach.

name: Ice Breath
desc: Spew icy breath to freeze enemies.

name: Ogre Berserker
desc: Allow rage to consume you to massively improve your physical powers for a time before the aftereffects set in.

name: Poisonous Breath
desc: Use your disgusting breath to corrode and nauseate your targets.

name: Possession
desc: Possess a weakened material body to gain access to a whole new world.

name: Scale Armor
desc: Like the lizardmen, move through water and mud with no penalties while receiving a slight defense buff.

name: Thunder Breath
desc: Release thunder from your mouth to damage foes in front of you.

name: Titanification
desc: Grow into a towering titan to massively increase your strength, defense, and reach while gaining immunity to magic from weaker foes.

name: Ultrasonic Waves
desc: Shoot out a screech of sound which damages physical bodies or use echolocation to highlight nearby entities.

name: Unpredictability
desc: In the hands of a True Hero, unpredictability reigns supreme. The Hero sees all, becoming able to ignore dodge and even read the movements of their opponent to disable their critical attacks or their dodge avoidance.

name: Water Breathing
desc: Remove the requirement of air underwater.

name: Corrosion Resistance
desc: Ignore weak corrosive effects or reduce the damage from stronger corrosive attacks.

name: Paralysis Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker paralysis effects or reduce the duration of stronger paralysis.

name: Poison Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker poisons or reduce the damage from more potent toxins.

name: Abnormal Condition Resistance
desc: Resist the effects of weaker abnormal conditions or reduce the severity of stronger ones.

name: Magic Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker magical attacks or reduce the damage from stronger spells.

name: Physical Attack Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker physical attacks or reduce the damage from stronger blows.

name: Spiritual Attack Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker spiritual attacks or resist stronger ones.

name: Cold Resistance
desc: Ignore weak cold damage or resist the damage of powerful attacks.

name: Darkness Attack Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker darkness damage or reduce the damage of stronger attacks.

name: Earth Attack Resistance
desc: Ignore weak earth-based damage or resist the damage from powerful attacks.

name: Electricity Resistance
desc: Ignore weak electrical damage or resist the damage from stronger attacks.

name: Flame Attack Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker flame damage or resist the damage from more powerful flames.

name: Gravity Attack Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker gravity-based damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.

name: Heat Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker heat-based damage or reduce the damage from stronger heat sources.

name: Holy Attack Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker holy attacks or reduce the damage from stronger divine powers.

name: Light Attack Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker light damage or reduce the damage from more powerful attacks.

name: Pain Resistance
desc: Resist pain effects.

name: Spatial Attack Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker spatial attacks or reduce the damage from stronger dimensional strikes.

name: Thermal Fluctuation Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker thermal damage regardless of its type or resist stronger attacks.

name: Water Attack Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker water-based damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.

name: Wind Attack Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker wind damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.

name: Absolute Severance
desc: Wield the power to cut through any who stand in your path, whether by coating your strikes or launching slashing projectiles that sever all in their path.

name: Analyst
desc: Enhance cognitive processing, analyze targets and phenomena, accelerate magic casting and deepen understanding of the laws of the world to optimize all actions.

name: Anti-Skill
desc: Become immune to damage from Magic, Skills and Battlewill, destroy barriers and block skill usage of other entities.

name: Berserk
desc: Massively empower your body and infuse it with a flame aura. Allows you to go into a risky but overwhelmingly powerful berserker mode.

name: Berserker
desc: Feed on your enemies' defeat. Gain EP from kills, destroy equipment faster, and boost your physical stats based on your power level.

name: Bewilder
desc: Manipulate friends and foes, compelling them to act according to your will.

name: Chef
desc: Purify and renew. Remove all negative effects and restore vitality to those under your care.

name: Chosen One
desc: Radiate authority and charisma to force fear into the hearts of your enemies and to make them follow you instead, while empowering yourself and your allies.

name: Commander
desc: Lead the charge with your allies. Empower yourself and your allies to give yourself an overwhelming advantage.

name: Cook
desc: Bend reality to ensure your enemies meet their demise by ignoring their dodge and barriers.

name: Creator
desc: Create any Unique Skill and use it for a limited amount of time.

name: Degenerate
desc: Craft, decraft, customize items and absorb strength from weakened enemies.

name: Divine Berserker
desc: Empower your body by a massive amount but beware the aftereffects.

name: Engorger
desc: Increase your size and boost your physical stats.

name: Envy
desc: Absorb strength from enemies, buff yourself and debilitate your enemies.

name: Falsifier
desc: See through falsehoods and invisibility, conceal your presence from prying eyes and create illusions.

name: Fighter
desc: Achieve mastery through discipline. Learn combat and magic abilities instantly, gain more mastery points, and hit much harder.

name: Fusionist
desc: Turn the world into a weapon, absorb the environment to create powerful mines and grenades.

name: Gluttony
desc: Absorb all in your path. None can win. Receive and provide skills, gain access to a spatial storage and mimic entities.

name: Godly Craftsman
desc: Utilize your years of experience to create masterpieces with ease and engrave your weapons for terrifying efficiency.

name: Gourmand
desc: Feast on the energy of your opponents. Steal magicule with your attacks and become more powerful when killing others.

name: Gourmet
desc: Absorb your enemies, gain new powers, and break down anything that stands in your way.

name: Great Sage
desc: Improve your cognitive skills to learn and cast faster, become able to appraise targets and use analysis to copy skills and process materials to craft or clone items or equipment.

name: Greed
desc: Take everything. Conquer the world and your enemies with it. Kill anyone who stands in your path while strengthening yourself or your allies.

name: Guardian
desc: Stand as a bastion against the force of your enemies. Absorb the damage from your allies and fortify their defenses.

name: Healer
desc: Mend wounds with a touch or unleash devastating afflictions, capable of both salvation and suffering.

name: Infinity Prison
desc: Trap enemies in an unbreakable dimensional cage or shield yourself from any threat with your dimensional barrier. Gain access to spatial storage.

name: Lust
desc: Assert your control over life and death. Drain your enemies of their strength or invigorate those under your wing.

name: Martial Master
desc: Empower your physical attacks, accelerate your thought process to react and dodge better while beating your enemies to submission.

name: Mathematician
desc: Use mathematics to improve your combat abilities, become able to use analytical appraisal to assess all.

name: Merciless
desc: Instantly kill weakened enemies or drain the life force of those who lack the will to fight or of those much weaker than you.

name: Murderer
desc: Disappear into the shadows and deal massive damage, also become undetectable by sound.

name: Musician
desc: Turn beautiful music into an instrument of destruction. Use sound to create powerful blasts which ignore armor.

name: Observer
desc: See all, evade all. Instinctively avoid attacks, detect concealed dangers, and identify hidden entities. Nothing escapes your watchful gaze.

name: Oppressor
desc: Dominate gravity yourself, control attractive and repulsive forces or unleash devastating ranged attacks which will crush anyone unfortunate enough to be in your path.

name: Predator
desc: Become the monster you were meant to be. Eat all. Analyze, craft and refine items, gain access to a spatial storage and mimic entities.

name: Pride
desc: Turn the strength of your opponents into your own and turn the tides of battle. Copy abilities when you are struck by them, provided you meet the necessary conditions.

name: Reaper
desc: Do recon by becoming smaller and more agile while seeing all enemies nearby. Spawn clones, or consume the essence of your enemies to obliterate them in a single strike.

name: Reflector
desc: Turn back the tides of battle by reflecting all of the received damage. Unleash a devastating projectile attack or counter an attack directly.

name: Researcher
desc: Study ancient magic tomes, reverse engineer them, and create wonders beyond imagination.

name: Reverser
desc: Flip the rules. Change alignments, invert buffs and debuffs while shifting strengths and weaknesses to your benefit.

name: Royal Beast
desc: Unleash a primal fury and gain a massive physical boost to crush your enemies.

name: Seeker
desc: Accelerate thought processing to extreme levels, mastery over magics and manipulate the fundamental laws governing the world to optimize actions and outcomes.

name: Seer
desc: See everything. Foresee your opponent’s moves. Dodge or mitigate their attacks and predict their movement to score critical strikes.

name: Severer
desc: Slice through reality and manifest spatial blades which cut through armor and unleash devastating blade storms.

name: Shadow Striker
desc: Become one with the shadows and deal massive spiritual damage and become immune to lesser presence detection.

name: Sloth
desc: Grind the world to a halt. Put your enemies into a deadly sleep, drain their power and rest to regain any lost vitality. May lethargy take over.

name: Sniper
desc: Deal damage from afar while using different bullets to get past resistances and ensure a quick kill.

name: Spearhead
desc: Empower and command your allies, and then collect their abilities once they pass on.

name: Starved
desc: Consume all in your path or have your rampaging subordinates do it. Corrode your enemies, devour their strength, and adding their abilities to your own.

name: Suppressor
desc: Restrict teleportation, confuse enemies by swapping places, and use your blink as well as the spatial gate to cross large distances.

name: Survivor
desc: Endure and outheal anything, resist physical and natural damage and withstand overwhelming odds.

name: Thrower
desc: Use your skill and your precision to throw anything and deal massive damage. You can even shove air or push back your foes.

name: Traveler
desc: Move freely through space, teleport large distances or create spatial gates. Manipulate stardust to immense damage.

name: Tuner
desc: Change your fate survive fatal blows, regenerate instantly and manipulate probability.

name: Unyielding
desc: Draw power from loyal allies. Fortify subordinates and seamlessly switch to a backup body to stay in the fight.

name: Usurper
desc: Seize your enemies' power or their summons. Steal their abilities and take control of their skills, draining their strength for your own.

name: Villain
desc: Embody malice and fight on the side of evil. Gain increased power from killing your foes, manipulate your enemies into joining your side and empower your allies.

name: Wrath
desc: Unleash pure rage and use it to get infinitely stronger the longer your anger persists. Beware of the devastating drawback.

name: Abnormal Condition Nullification
desc: Completely negate all abnormal conditions and their effects.

name: Absorb & Dissolve
desc: Dissolve specific items to instantly consume them.

name: Acid Rain
desc: Summon an acidic cloud which will corrode any afflicted entities.

name: Acid Shell
desc: Shoots a ball of corrosive acid toward targets.

name: Aerial Blade
desc: Pull in any nearby entities before dealing massive damage by unleashing the power of your spirit.

name: Agility
desc: Greatly enhance the caster's movement speed.

name: Air Flight
desc: Use your aura to propel you forward, and hover in air.

name: Airflow Shut
desc: Drain out all the air surrounding the targets and suffocate them.

name: Analyze
desc: Analyze targets' status and power.

name: Anti-Magic Area
desc: Creates a zone around the user that limits all Aspectual and Summoning Magics.

name: Anti-Shock Area
desc: Creates a zone around the user that limits all physical damage taken.

name: Antidote
desc: Recover a living being from nausea, poison and weakness.

name: Aura Shield
desc: Create a shield of condensed aura to block attacks.

name: Aura Slash
desc: Condense your aura along your blade and release ranged slash.

name: Aura Sword
desc: Coat your weapon in aura enhancing its blows.

name: Barrier
desc: Coat the caster with a Physical Barrier with the strength based on Health.

name: Battlewill
desc: Channel your will, converting magicules into aura.

name: Blizzard
desc: Creates a powerful storm of ice to slow your enemies and turn the tides of battle.

name: Bullet Punch
desc: You can only be fast, and go even faster. On the next attack, you speed up and deliver four quick attacks.

name: Burden
desc: Shoot energy projectiles that increase the target's gravity.

name: Butcher
desc: Slice, dice, and feel your hunger. Your thirst for the hunt is unquenching, so grab a plate and have a taste.

name: Captivator
desc: Your previous life, you were the brightest, shining star. Your ability to turn lies into truths… Perhaps it’s the other way around? Whatever it may be, your eyes shine brilliantly in response to being on the biggest stage.

name: Chain Explosion
desc: Summon a sequence of explosion that detonates in a chain around targets.

name: Clairvoyance
desc: Increase the caster's eye sight.

name: Clangorous Soul
desc: Your soul, your beats. Your shell is hard, and makes wonderful noises when it is banged against. Maybe it can help you.

name: Coalescence
desc: Freeze, stop and stagnate. Prevent hindering effects from applying to you and cause others to halt and solidify.

name: Cold Nullification
desc: Completely ignore cold damage.

name: Confusion
desc: Apply vision confusion to surrounding targets.

name: Constant
desc: Use magicules to force differing stats to remain the same. Become nigh invincible for a short period of time while

name: Corroder

name: Corrosion Nullification
desc: Completely negate all corrosion damage.

name: Corrosion Transform
desc: Channel your inner corrosion to burn and bleed the flesh off your enemies.

name: Crasher
desc: The essence of "deletion". Completely and utterly erase your foes from the plane of existence with the power of your sheer will alone.

name: Create Greater Undead
desc: Call forth armed undead from the ground to aid the caster.

name: Create Lesser Undead
desc: Call forth weak undead from the ground to aid the caster.

name: Cryogenic Cessation
desc: Command your absolute authority over Deceleration, allowing you to freeze all enemies with ice and spew superchilled ice. Additionally, freeze the surroundings into ice

name: Cultivator
desc: Embody the relentless pursuit of ascension, gathering and refining energy to reach unparalleled heights. A Cultivator walks the path of self-perfection and dominion over all.

name: Curse
desc: Release Miasmic Mist to curse targets.

name: Curse Bind
desc: Call forth spirits of the death to bind and corrode targets.

name: Dark Cube
desc: Create a cube of darkness that slows movement and deals constant damage.

name: Dark Eight Palms
desc: Launch up to eight devastating aura blasts at foes.

name: Darkness
desc: Call on your spirit to reduce the enemy's vision in a wide area.

name: Darkness Attack Nullification
desc: Completely nullify all darkness damage.

name: Darkness Cannon
desc: Shoot a long beam which deals massive damage, destroys armor and debilitates enemies.

name: Darkness Domination
desc: Boosts the power of Dark abilities by a large amount.

name: Darkness Manipulation
desc: Boosts the power of Dark abilities by a decent amount.

name: Darkness Transform
desc: Channel your inner darkness to burn and blind nearby opponents.

name: Death March Dance
desc: Gather your aura into a ring of devastating aura spheres that come crashing down.

name: Demon Dominate
desc: Dominate over any targets up to the Calamity level.

name: Demon Marionette
desc: Dominate over any targets even at the Disaster level.

name: Diamond Path
desc: Harden your aura around you to block incoming attacks.

name: Dimension Cutter
desc: Tear space to send forward a blade of dimension rift.

name: Discharge
desc: Strike a bolt of lightning using your inner bio-electricity generated from a sac within you. Can be used without thundering weather.

name: Dissonance
desc: You are the calamity. You are the storm, and you are approaching. Strike lightning in all cardinal directions that deal massive Electricity Damage to all those unfortunate to be hit by it.

name: Dominate
desc: Dominate over any low-leveled targets.

name: Doppelganger
desc: Use percentages of the user's magical power to create identical clones around them.

name: Drainage
desc: Drain the water around the caster.

name: Dreamer
desc: Dream a dream so grand it becomes a nightmare... Gain control over the forces of life and death, allowing you to cheat death and restore yourself back to a "save point".

name: Earth
desc: Place down blocks which mimic those from the surrounding environment.

name: Earth Attack Nullification
desc: Completely nullify all earth damage.

name: Earth Domination
desc: Boosts the power of  Earth abilities by a large amount.

name: Earth Jail
desc: Restrict and weaken a single target, applying debuffs to allow you to finish them off.

name: Earth Lock
desc: Solidify the earth where the caster desires.

name: Earth Spikes
desc: Raises earth spikes from the ground to pierce through your enemies.

name: Earth Storm
desc: Summons a viscous sandstorm and falling rocks around you.

name: Earth Transform
desc: Channel the powers of the earth to deal increased damage and increase local gravity around you.

name: Earth Wall
desc: Call forth giant earth walls from the ground.

name: Earthshatter Kick
desc: Stomp your foot down upheaving the land around you.

name: Eight Petals Flash
desc: Dash and attack the target's eyes, throat, heart, kidneys, lungs, and groin with eight consecutive and near instant slashes.

name: Electricity Nullification
desc: Completely nullify all electricity damage.

name: Electro Blast
desc: Fire a beam attack that pierces through enemies and deals devastating damage while paralyzing your enemies.

name: Elephant Stampede
desc: Throw a ring of aura spheres around you.

name: Engineer
desc: Tinkering and tinkering. No one understood the machines as much as you did. In fact, no one understood you either. Perhaps it was always meant to be.

name: Escape
desc: Connect two points in space to create a escape route.

name: Exoskeleton
desc: The Insects of the other world all possess this tough Exoskeleton. It grows together with the user, and even allows them to wear armor on top of it.

name: Explosion
desc: Summon a single beam of light, that detonates at the target, creating a devastating blast of pure magical power.

name: Farsight
desc: Focus your eyes and become able to see things far away.

name: Fire
desc: Use your spirit to start a small fire.

name: Fire
desc: Shoot magic fiery projectiles.

name: Fire Ball
desc: Shoot concentrated balls of fire.

name: Fire Bolt
desc: Shoots a flaming bolt.

name: Fire Breath
desc: Breathe flames and incinerate your enemies.

name: Fire Lance
desc: Shoot fiery lances of magic.

name: Fire Storm
desc: Call forth fiery surges of flame to incinerate targets.

name: Fire Wall
desc: Create a wall of fire to keep targets away.

name: Five Petals Thrust
desc: Dash and pierce the opponent in five of ten vital points and uses the other five as feints.

name: Flame Attack Nullification
desc: Completely nullify all flame damage.

name: Flame Domination
desc: Boosts the power of fire abilities by a large amount.

name: Flame Transform
desc: Channel the powers of fire to burn all nearby foes.

name: Flame Wall
desc: Create a wall of illusional fire to keep targets away.

name: Flare Circle
desc: Opens a Gate to Hell from which wicked flames erupt to turn your enemies to ash.

name: Flight
desc: Propel the caster forward in the air.

name: Float
desc: Decrease the caster's gravity to float.

name: Formhide
desc: Match your aura to the surroundings, which makes you imperceptible.

name: Freeze
desc: Solidify water sources into ice.

name: Full Recovery
desc: Recover a living being's health and food points to the maximum as well as Absorption.

name: Gardener
desc: The crops, the wild, everything was there for you. You sow the seeds and wish only for a bountiful harvest. And in turn, the crops bless you.

name: Gate
desc: Tear space asunder connecting two points in space.

name: Gravitational Void
desc: A black hole sucking everything into a singularity

name: Gravity Attack Nullification
desc: Completely nullify all gravity damage.

name: Gravity Domination
desc: Boosts Gravity abilities by a large amount and allows you to fly without hindrance.

name: Gravity Flux
desc: Utilise the power of gravity to disrupt the target's movement and hamper their ability to move.

name: Haze
desc: Wrap yourself in a cloak of aura concealing yourself from even the most heightened of senses.

name: Healing
desc: Heal a living being on a low level.

name: Healing Rain
desc: Call forth a rain of healing in a wide radius.

name: Healthcare
desc: Boost the caster's health and saturation.

name: Heat Nullification
desc: Completely negate all heat damage.

name: Heavy Slash
desc: Channel your aura into your arms and bring down a mountain-splitting slash.

name: Hell Hall
desc: Rupture the floor, raising your natural body temperature to liquefy all surfaces around you to molten levels.

name: Hellfire
desc: Summon a sphere of hellfire to deal massive damage in a small area.

name: Hidden Ruler
desc: Inspire your allies. Conscript allies in the dark. Copy abilities from your foes and Paste them onto allies.

name: Holy Attack Nullification
desc: Completely nullify all holy damage.

name: Hypnos
desc: Put even the strongest entities into sleep.

name: Ice Blizzard
desc: Create a powerful storm of snow to freeze your enemies.

name: Ice Breaker
desc: Shoot a giant icicle spear toward targets.

name: Ice Domination
desc: Boosts the power of ice abilities by a large amount.

name: Ice Manipulation
desc: Boosts the power of ice abilities by a decent amount.

name: Ice Wall
desc: Call forth walls of ice upon targets.

name: Icicle Lance
desc: Shoot frozen icicles toward targets.

name: Icicle Rain
desc: Strike targets with a barrage of icicle lances from the sky.

name: Icicle Spear
desc: Strike targets with a giant icicle spike from the ground.

name: Instant-move
desc: Gather your aura at your feet to travel faster than the eye can see.

name: Invisible
desc: Turn the caster invisible to hide from targets.

name: Kyurem
desc: A husk of what you formally were. The leftovers, discarded without a second thought when the split happened. Coldness seeps through your skin as you freeze everything to reclaim your other parts.

name: Lethal Poison
desc: As the King of Scorpions, your poison is highly dangerous. An upgrade to the Poison skill. Can only be used by King Scorpions and their evolutionary line.

name: Light
desc: Summons a temporary light to block out the darkness.

name: Light Attack Nullification
desc: Completely nullify all light damage.

name: Light Domination
desc: Boosts the power of Light abilities by a large amount.

name: Light Manipulation
desc: Boosts the power of light abilities by a decent amount.

name: Light Transform
desc: Channel your inner light to deal light damage and nauseate all nearby entities.

name: Lighten
desc: Lighten the caster's gravity for greater speed and jump power.

name: Lightning Domination
desc: Boosts Lightning abilities by a large amount.

name: Lightning Lance
desc: Launch a lighting projectile which will electrify your enemies.

name: Lightning Mode
desc: Burst forth with an incredible speed boost, gaining doubled EP temporarily on top of higher damage. Beware of the terrible drawbacks.

name: Liquidize
desc: Liquidize the earth where the caster desires to turn into deadly traps.

name: Magic Barrier
desc: Coat the caster with a Magic Barrier with the strength based on Health.

name: Magic Bullet
desc: Gather your aura into a powerful blast.

name: Magic Darkness Transform
desc: Gain access to the intermediate Darkness Spirit Magic and boost your darkness attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.

name: Magic Earth Transform
desc: Gain access to the intermediate Earth Spirit Magic and boost your earth attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.

name: Magic Flame Transform
desc: Gain access to the intermediate Flame Spirit Magic and boost your fire attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.

name: Magic Light Transform
desc: Gain access to the intermediate Light Spirit Magic and boost your light attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.

name: Magic Nullification
desc: Completely negate all magic damage.

name: Magic Space Transform
desc: Gain access to the intermediate Space Spirit Magic and boost your spatial attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.

name: Magic Wall
desc: Generate a magic wall to protect the caster.

name: Magic Water Transform
desc: Gain access to the intermediate Water Spirit Magic and boost your water attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.

name: Magic Wind Transform
desc: Gain access to the intermediate Wind Spirit Magic and boost your wind attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.

name: Magisteel Body
desc: Have a body made of magisteel, making it much harder and gaining progressively stronger armor depending on your EP.

name: Magma Surge
desc: Fire a spread of lava that burns and melts anything for a limited time.

name: Malleable
desc: Malleable like clay, the tides of fate are yours to mold to your desire. Your body seems to work like the metal of a forge, hardening and relaxing under pressure, as you merge yourself with the elements around you.

name: Maximum Magic Bullet
desc: Gather your aura into a gargantuan blast obliterating all who dare oppose you.

name: Megiddo
desc: Unleash powerful sun blasts using water to kill any nearby foes. It can also be used manually to concentrate fire for any stronger foes.

name: Melancholy
desc: Summon an aura of sorrow that slows and weakens nearby enemies, filling them with despair. The skill also throws objects or air, amplifying the feeling of hopelessness around you.

name: Mental Crush
desc: Crush the mind of targets.

name: Mirage
desc: Create illusionary clones around the caster.

name: Mithril Strength
desc: Turn your muscles as hard as Mithril and gain an increase in damage, toggleable when mastered.

name: Mud Hand
desc: Bind targets with several hands of mud.

name: Mud Spears
desc: Raise mud spikes from the ground to pierce through your enemies.

name: Ogre Flame
desc: Use your aura to create a pillar of fire.

name: Ogre-sword Cannon
desc: Condense your aura into a blade projectile.

name: Ogre-sword Guillotine
desc: Coat your weapon in aura enhancing its blows.

name: Pain Nullification
desc: Completely negate all pain effects.

name: Paralysing Breath
desc: Spew a horrifying breath to paralyze your prey.

name: Paralysis Nullification
desc: Completely negate all paralysis effects.

name: Paralysis Transform
desc: Channel your inner paralysis to emit paralysing enzymes that make your target go numb just from your presence.

name: Phaser
desc: Your eyes shift. They become able to see things you normally weren't able to see before... And you become able to do things you weren't able to do before.

name: Physical Attack Nullification
desc: Completely negate all physical damage.

name: Pierce Nullification
desc: Completely negate all piercing damage.

name: Pierce Resistance
desc: Ignore weaker piercing damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.

name: Poison Nullification
desc: Completely nullify all poison damage.

name: Poison Transform
desc: Channel your inner poison to inject deadly venom's into your target through their every pore.

name: Possession
desc: Possess a weakened material body to gain a new powers from that body.

name: Profaned Prominence
desc: Command your absolute authority over Acceleration, allowing you to inflict all enemies with fire and spew superheated flames. Additionally, melt the surroundings into magma.

name: Protection
desc: Greatly enhance the caster's defence.

name: Provider
desc: The more you give away, the more you feel closer to yourself. Perhaps it even strengthens you along the way.

name: Recovery
desc: Greatly recover a living being's health as well as food points.

name: Reducer
desc: Manipulate and wield the power of energy itself, being able to channel the power of the holy element into super strong attacks.

name: Reincarnation
desc: Sacrifice a portion of the caster's power to reincarnate.

name: Reinforced Barrier
desc: Coat the caster with reinforced Barriers with the strength based on Health.

name: Reinforcement
desc: Greatly enhance the caster's gears durability.

name: Relapse
desc: Collapse back into whence you came. Your memory is fleeting and the people you once knew start to forget you as well. Relapse and claim what belongs to you.

name: Repeater
desc: Through the lens, you trap light. You do something special, and you feel like you’ve already done it in millions of realities. Like the things you’ve done and led up to this moment were predestined. Maybe you can change that.

name: Reshiram
desc: You seek to build a world of truths. Are you prepared to scorch and burn everything in your path to make the truthful world you seek so badly?

name: Restricted
desc: You were cursed from birth. Your raw, unfiltered potential, blocked by a curse gifted by the heavens. Your skill... It's stopping you from learning other skills. But why...?

name: Roaring Lion Punch
desc: Focus your aura into a fearsome blow with the regalness of a lion.

name: Scholar
desc: Learn and master skills quicker. Study your targets when they attack. Learn enchantments and apply them to weaponry.

name: Schrödinger
desc: Is it alive, or is it dead? The only way to find out is to open the box. But since it's a cat, maybe it'll grant you some of its properties.

name: Search Enemy
desc: Highlight hostile mobs around the caster.

name: Sense Soundwave
desc: Empower your ears to precisely locate any nearby entities.

name: Shadow Bind
desc: If the target is standing in shadows, bind them and deal spiritual damage.

name: Shrink
desc: Reduce your size to enhance your evasion but increase your vulnerability

name: Sleep Mist
desc: Release a wide area of sleeping mist to paralyze targets.

name: Solar Beam
desc: Fire a light beam that deals massive damage to undead entities and burns blocks.

name: Solar Flare
desc: Shoot a shockwave of light energy to give nausea, blindness and slowness to all targets in a wide AOE.

name: Solar Rain
desc: Shoot many light projectiles that deal massive damage to undead creatures.

name: Solar Wave
desc: Shoot a wave of light energy that blinds and slows hit enemies.

name: Sound Domination
desc: Boosts Sound abilities by a large amount.

name: Space
desc: Form invisible platforms to create footholds midair.

name: Space Transform
desc: Channel the powers of space to weaken and damage all nearby entities.

name: Spark
desc: Light your weapon and fists aflame, igniting your next target on fire for a short period of time.

name: Spatial Attack Nullification
desc: Completely nullify all spatial damage.

name: Spatial Domination
desc: Boosts Space abilities by a large amount and deals massive damage by splitting a target with dimensional attacks.

name: Spatial Storage
desc: Rift space to create a small pocket dimension to store items.

name: Spiritual Attack Nullification
desc: Completely negate all spiritual damage.

name: Spiritualist
desc: The souls of the world flock to you, the one who can both see and commune with the dead. Through your knowledge of the occult, harvest souls and use them to empower your attacks.

name: Stagnator
desc: Cease all change. The times call for it. Prevent targets from moving or regenerating, and stop all things from harming you.

name: Stone Shot
desc: Shoot rock spikes toward targets.

name: Strength
desc: Greatly enhance the caster's strength power.

name: Subjugator
desc: You've always been a powerful manipulator. Capable of bringing anyone and anything under your control. ...But, something is strange...

name: Summon Basilisk
desc: Summon a Basilisk to temporarily fight for you.

name: Summon Daemon
desc: Summon a Daemon from hell to fight for you.

name: Summon Greater Elemental
desc: Summon your contracted greater elemental spirit to have it purge the world of heretics for you.

name: Summon Hound Dog
desc: Summon a Hound Dog to temporarily fight for you.

name: Summon Medium Elemental
desc: Summon your contracted elemental spirit to temporarily fight for you.

name: Summon Otherworlder
desc: Summon a human from a different world.

name: Swipe
desc: Slashing through space in a straight line, displacing entities or teleporting the caster.

name: Teleport
desc: Quickly blink forward in space to a location within view.

name: Tenacity
desc: Become tenacious and repair your body. Since magic and mana itself has rejected you, utilise your pure aura alone.

name: Thermal Fluctuation Nullification
desc: Completely negate all thermal damage.

name: Thunder
desc: Strike powerful thunder where the caster looks.

name: Thunder Lance
desc: Strike powerful thunder lances of magic.

name: Thunder Orb
desc: Call forth a sphere of thunder that strikes any enemy get by.

name: Thunder Rain
desc: Call forth a wide area of thunder clouds that strike all enemies.

name: Tornado Blade
desc: Fire a concentrated sphere of wind toward targets.

name: True Darkness
desc: Inflict Blindness on all entities and deal massive spiritual damage.

name: Victorious Harbinger
desc: You are the forerunner of victory, your presence declares near fated victory, shatter the morale of your enemies and have no doubt in your abilities.

name: Violent Break
desc: Channel your aura, recklessly enhancing your strength and cleansing you of any negative effects.

name: Warp Portal
desc: Tear space asunder connecting two points in space.

name: Water
desc: Call forth or manipulate small amounts of water.

name: Water
desc: Call forth small amounts of water.

name: Water Attack Nullification
desc: Completely nullify all water damage.

name: Water Cutter
desc: Fires a concentrated blade to cut your enemies with the power of water.

name: Water Cutter
desc: Fire concentrated blades of water toward targets.

name: Water Domination
desc: Boosts Water abilities by a large amount.

name: Water Jail
desc: Surround targets with flows of water.

name: Water Transform
desc: Channel the powers of water to damage and poison all nearby foes.

name: Weather Domination
desc: Use magicule to manipulate the weather with a higher efficiency.

name: Wind
desc: Call forth a small gust of wind which can push targets away or the player up.

name: Wind Attack Nullification
desc: Completely nullify all wind damage.

name: Wind Blade
desc: Fires a concentrated blade of wind which has heavy knockback.

name: Wind Cutter
desc: Fire concentrated blades of wind toward targets.

name: Wind Domination
desc: Boosts Wind abilities by a large amount.

name: Wind Gust
desc: Release strong currents of winds to create gusts or wind charges toward targets.

name: Wind Protection
desc: Call forth flows of wind to coat the caster with speed and protection.

name: Wind Transform
desc: Channel the powers of wind to paralyze and damage all nearby entities.

name: Zekrom
desc: You seek to build a world of ideals. Be warned as not everyone shares the same ideals. Raze anything in your path with a clap of lightning.
